name: Delray Beach
dining_districts: the beachside hotel kitchens along A1A
intro: Atlantic Avenue is one of Florida's great restaurant streets — a mile-plus of chef-driven dining rooms, rooftop bars, and brunch patios running shoulder to shoulder from Swinton to the ocean, with Pineapple Grove's arts-district kitchens adding depth a block north. The Avenue's rhythm is brutal: brunch volume that rivals dinner, season that doubles everything, and menus that pivot fast in a town where diners chase what's new.

That rhythm is why Delray kitchens use us. Trucks out of Pompano Beach — thirty minutes south — land before prep; split cases keep experimental menus honest; the bar programs run their own citrus and garnish standing orders; and when Saturday brunch wipes out the walk-in, the midnight cutoff has Sunday covered.
route_note: About 30 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse — Atlantic Avenue and beachside stops land early on the Palm Beach coastal run.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to Atlantic Avenue restaurants before brunch service?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Weekend routes run like weekdays with 4 AM dispatch, so Avenue kitchens have produce racked before brunch prep — the heaviest service of the week here.

faqs_unique.q: Can bar programs on the Avenue run separate citrus and garnish orders?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Many Delray bars hold their own standing order for juice citrus, herbs, and garnish produce, delivered alongside the kitchen's cases.

cta_text: Share your Atlantic Avenue service rhythm, brunch volume, bar garnish needs, or event calendar. We will help your Delray Beach kitchen set produce pars that hold up through busy shifts.
